limitations: One board per chip, one AP and room-temperature conditions; no calibrated RF measurement or long-duration reliability claim.
Receive gain IQ/DC calibration replaced. C3 retains TX calibration; S3 also retains two RX spur helpers. Analog callbacks and ROM dependencies remain.
Original-instruction oracle compares ordered modeled boundary behavior; it does not prove cycle timing, RF or analog equivalence.
Packet gaps and latency tails remain open; this comparison records actual counts without claiming a fix.
AP Ethernet captures corroborate EAPOL exchanges but are not complete independent RF captures.

timing_observations.limits: Cumulative metrics cannot correlate a particular packet with an operation. Group losses in the comparison are preserved separately. No cycle-equivalence or packet-loss fix is claimed.

final_board_state.esp32c3: ordinary source app completed and disconnected
final_board_state.esp32s3: held in ROM by paired flasher; ordinary source app retained

validation_notes: Actual emitted gain-calibration instructions and ELF constants checked in all eight source profiles. Every PC and conditional edge is covered without coverage exemptions.

Original traces cover scalar narrowing, channel counts, carried coefficients, signed packed outputs, live table changes and caller-buffer mutations/aliases. The original C3 unreachable upper-clamp instruction/edge has an exhaustive four-attempt proof; native coverage needs no exemptions. Analog effects remain outside the model.

Caller-buffer accesses retain their widths and order; actual consumed buffer pointers determine canonical stack locations. Private stack spills and immutable loads are excluded. The S3 caller supplies ten arguments; the final argument is unused. Private fixed readonly ROM memcpy calls are represented by equivalent constant initialization.
All retained calibration input names and sizes are compared across the four profiles; differences, if present, are recorded explicitly.
Images were built at the implementation commit; recorded source file hashes and Cargo locks bind them to the stated revision. The control has only the identical passive lifetime probe overlay.
Local Cargo repro tests use installed Rust 1.91.0; serial tests use the ESP-IDF Python environment with pyserial 3.5. Default toolchains and locks are unchanged.
